one_liner: Jira Cloud has a broad, free, self-serve REST v3 API with OAuth 2.0 (3LO) and API tokens, plus an official Atlassian Rovo MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) with scopes is self-serve for multi-user access. API tokens are used with Basic auth (email:token). Connect uses JWT. Forge is the app platform.
access_notes: The REST API is free on all Jira plans, including Free. User API tokens need no approval. Points-based rate limits apply to apps from March 2026.
blocker_notes: Rate limits are tightening, and per-tenant quotas may need Atlassian review. These do not block building a toolkit.

evidence.quote: Access to the REST APIs is free for all Jira plans.
Jira Cloud free plan provides API access (up to 10 users, 2GB storage)
Choice of user API tokens, OAuth 2.0 (3LO) with scopes, Connect JWT, or Forge scoped permissions.
Jira Cloud REST API v3 documented at developer.atlassian.com, with JQL search exposed as a first-class endpoint.
Issues, projects, boards, sprints, workflows, users, permissions, and audit records, with bulk issue endpoints.
The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server is a cloud-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects AI-powered clients to your Atlassian Cloud apps.
